title_en: Wang Chunlin v. Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory — dispute over prize-bearing savings deposit certificate (retrial)

full_text_en:
Wang Chunlin v. Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory — Dispute over Prize-bearing Savings Certificate

Applicant for Retrial (Defendant at First Instance, Appellant at Second Instance): Wang Chunlin, female, 38 years old, statistician at Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory, Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region, residing in Yinchuan.

Respondent (Plaintiff at First Instance, Appellee at Second Instance): Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory, Yinchuan, Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region.

Legal Representative: Zhang Ningtao, Factory Manager.

Agent ad litem: He Jianguo, cadre of Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory.

The applicant for retrial, Wang Chunlin, dissatisfied with the final civil judgment of Yinchuan Intermediate People's Court (1994) Yin Min Zhong Zi No. 200 in the dispute with Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory over a prize-bearing savings certificate, applied to the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region High People's Court for retrial on the ground that the prize money she obtained was lawful income and did not constitute unjust enrichment. The Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region High People's Court, finding that the original final judgment was indeed erroneous, ordered, in accordance with Article 179(1)(3) and Article 183 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, to bring the case up for retrial. The following facts were found upon trial:

On June 26, 1993, Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory purchased 100 fixed-term, fixed-amount prize-bearing savings certificates with a face value of RMB 100 each from the Zhonghu Sub-branch of the Bank of China Yinchuan Branch. The back of the certificates indicated a winning rate of 100%. On July 10, 1993, the Bank of China Yinchuan Branch held a public lottery, publishing the winning numbers on page 4 of the Ningxia Daily, and stipulated that the redemption period would be from July 15 to October 15, 1993, after which unclaimed prizes would be forfeited. During this period, Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory never redeemed the certificates. On October 15, 1993, the last day of the redemption period, Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory distributed the prize-bearing savings certificates to its employees in lieu of overdue wages. After receiving the certificate, the factory employee Wang Chunlin verified that certificate No. 003172 had won the first prize of RMB 10,000. Wang Chunlin then took the certificate to the bank and received the prize money. Upon learning of Wang Chunlin's winnings, Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory claimed that the prize money should belong to the factory, arguing that the failure to redeem on time was due to the negligence of the factory's management in not being aware of the winning situation. It demanded that Wang Chunlin return the RMB 10,000 to the factory, and that the factory would give Wang Chunlin RMB 1,888 as a "lucky prize." Wang Chunlin refused the factory's request, leading to a dispute. Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory then filed a lawsuit with Yinchuan City District People's Court, requesting a judgment ordering Wang Chunlin to return the RMB 10,000 prize money.

The Yinchuan City District People's Court held that the Bank's prize-bearing savings certificate No. 003172 had won a prize in the public lottery on July 10, 1993, thereby increasing the certificate's value from its face value of RMB 100 to RMB 10,100. At that time, Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory was the lawful holder of the appreciated certificate, and the RMB 10,000 prize money was the lawful income of the holder. Due to the negligence of the factory's management in failing to ascertain the winning status of the certificate, it distributed the certificate, now worth RMB 10,100, to Wang Chunlin at its face value of RMB 100. In accordance with Article 59(1)(1) of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, the conduct of Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory constituted a material mistake and was a voidable civil act. Pursuant to Article 92 of the General Principles of the Civil Law, Wang Chunlin, having obtained the certificate and subsequently the RMB 10,000 prize money under circumstances where the other party acted under a material mistake, had obtained unjust enrichment without legal grounds and was obligated to return it. Although Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory indicated that after Wang Chunlin returned the RMB 10,000, it would give her RMB 1,888 as a "lucky prize," Wang Chunlin refused the gift. In accordance with Article 128 of the Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Implementation of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China (For Trial Implementation), the gift relationship could not be established. Accordingly, on May 20, 1994, the Yinchuan City District People's Court rendered judgment: Wang Chunlin shall return the unjust enrichment of RMB 10,000 to Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory within 15 days after the judgment takes effect; failure to do so shall result in legal liability.

After the first-instance judgment was pronounced, Wang Chunlin appealed to the Yinchuan Intermediate People's Court on the ground that the first-instance court had improperly applied the law and the judgment was erroneous. After trial in the second instance, the Yinchuan Intermediate People's Court held that the facts found in the first-instance judgment were clear, the law applied was correct, and the judgment was appropriate. The appellant Wang Chunlin's appeal was unfounded, and on August 8, 1994, the court rendered judgment: Appeal dismissed; original judgment affirmed.

The Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region High People's Court, upon trial, held:

(I) Wang Chunlin's acquisition of the RMB 10,000 prize money did not constitute unjust enrichment. Unjust enrichment refers to obtaining a benefit without legal or contractual basis, causing loss to another's property. The Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory's act of using the prize-bearing certificates to replace employee wages was a genuine expression of intent. In the complaint at first instance, the factory explicitly stated that due to financial difficulties, it distributed the purchased certificates, each with a face value of RMB 100, to employees in lieu of wages, and that there was no prior agreement regarding the prize money. The original applicant's (Wang Chunlin's) acquisition of the prize-bearing savings certificate was lawful and valid, and therefore the RMB 10,000 she obtained did not constitute unjust enrichment.

(II) The fact that Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory failed to lawfully obtain the RMB 10,000 prize money did not constitute a material mistake. A civil act based on a material mistake refers to an act where the actor has a mistaken understanding of a material aspect of the civil act and performs the civil act based on that mistaken understanding. Investigation revealed that on April 27, 1993, the Bank of China Ningxia Branch published an announcement in the Ningxia Daily titled "First Prize of 1.53 Million Yuan at Bank of China, Every Certificate Wins. Bank of China Ningxia Branch Launches the Second Phase of Fixed-Term Fixed-Amount Prize-Bearing Savings." The announcement stated: "From May 1, 1993, Bank of China Ningxia Branch will issue fixed-term fixed-amount prize-bearing savings certificates at all its institutions and outlets throughout the region... Each certificate has a face value of RMB 100, a term of two years, non-transferable, non-reportable loss, non-redeemable before maturity, winning rate 100%." On June 26, 1993, when Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory purchased the fixed-term fixed-amount prize-bearing savings certificates from the Zhonghu Sub-branch of the Bank of China Yinchuan Branch, Article 2 of the "Instructions for the Bearer" on the back of the certificate stated: "Upon completion of each issuance group, our bank will, together with the notary department, conduct a public lottery to determine the winning numbers... Winning rate 100%." On July 11, 1993, the Bank of China Ningxia Branch held a public lottery and published the winning numbers on page 4 of the Ningxia Daily, specifying a redemption period of three months (July 15 to October 15) for the special prize, lucky prize, first prize, second prize, and third prize; failure to redeem within this period would be deemed forfeiture. Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory should have known of the above provisions. Moreover, the dozens of other factory workers who received prize-bearing savings certificates also received prize money, albeit of varying amounts, but the nature of winning was the same. Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory did not demand the return of prize money from other workers, which sufficiently proves that it had no misunderstanding regarding the possibility of the prize-bearing savings certificates winning a prize. The determination in the original judgment that Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory's transfer of the certificate to Wang Chunlin constituted a material mistake cannot be sustained.

(III) The RMB 10,000 prize money should belong to Wang Chunlin. A fixed-term fixed-amount prize-bearing savings certificate is a negotiable security whose property rights can only be realized by actual possession and presentation at maturity. The exercise of rights under a negotiable security cannot be separated from the security; the bearer of the security is the right holder, and without the security, the right cannot be asserted. The property rights represented on a negotiable security are, for the bearer, merely an expectant creditor's right. In this case, the RMB 100 face value recorded on the prize-bearing savings certificate and the RMB 10,000 prize money obtainable upon winning constitute an expectant creditor's right. Until the certificate matures and is presented by the bearer to the obligor, it cannot be considered that the creditor has fully taken possession of the property corresponding to the creditor's right. Only when the bearer presents the certificate to the obligor within the agreed period to demand performance can the bearer achieve full possession of the RMB 10,100 property. Therefore, the determination in the original judgment that the certificate appreciated to RMB 10,100 upon winning, and that the RMB 10,000 prize money was the lawful income of Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory during its period of lawful possession of the certificate, is erroneous. Article 72 of the General Principles of the Civil Law provides: "Property ownership shall not be obtained in violation of the law. Unless the law provides otherwise or the parties have agreed otherwise, property ownership shall be transferred at the time of delivery when property is acquired by contract or other lawful means." In this case, the certificate was voluntarily transferred by Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory to Wang Chunlin, and no agreement was made at the time of transfer regarding the right to the prize money. Wang Chunlin, by presenting the certificate to the bank and demanding performance, achieved full possession of the RMB 10,000 prize money, which is in accordance with the law. From the moment Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory voluntarily transferred the certificate, it could no longer assert any property rights under the certificate.

In conclusion, Wang Chunlin's application for retrial has sufficient grounds and should be sustained. The original judgments at first and second instance applied the law incorrectly and rendered inappropriate decisions, which should be modified. Accordingly, in accordance with Article 184 of the Civil Procedure Law, the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region High People's Court rendered judgment on March 27, 1995:

1.  The civil judgment (1993) Cheng Min Chu Zi No. 1008 of Yinchuan City District People's Court and the civil judgment (1994) Yin Min Zhong Zi No. 200 of Yinchuan Intermediate People's Court are hereby vacated.

2.  The claim of the Respondent at first instance, Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory, for the return of the RMB 10,000 prize money from the Applicant at first instance, Wang Chunlin, is dismissed.

The court costs for the first instance and second instance, each amounting to RMB 410, shall be borne by Yinchuan Aluminum Profile Factory.
